candidate_windows.window_text: We use Huggingface Transformers (Wolf et al., 2020) to access all task and evaluation models. We train each model for up to 20 epochs with a learning rate $5e - 6$ and a batch size 8. All experiments were performed on a single NVIDIA RTX 8000 GPU. Table 3 shows input-output formatings of different task models for different tasks.
